g.title: system-architecture
g.text: Three layers. No server and no server-held keys.

g.title: cluster_client
g.text: Payer's browser. Static build, no backend.

g.title: cluster_build
g.text: Runs on the developer machine, not in production

g.title: csv
g.text: CSV: invoice ID, payee, amount, salt

g.title: wallet
g.text: Holds the key, signs every tx

g.title: payout
g.text: Emits InvoicePaid per line, BatchPaid per batch

g.title: studio
g.text: Iterations deploy to Arc testnet only
